fuel_and_sample.value: 41 samples: thin flat SIBAL cotton-fiberglass (12 cm x 1 or 2 cm), Nomex, Ultem; thick PMMA and wax-fiberglass slabs; PMMA spheres (1 and 2 cm); candles in tubes
